subject: PO activation window, invoice cutover, and net60 exception request
messages:
From: Kelly Barnes <kelly.barnes@orionthera.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-07-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO activation window and invoice cadence for Redwood deployment

Hi Jordan,

Quick question from procurement as we get close to final signatures: Orion needs a blanket PO that can be activated effective the day the first invoice is posted. Our requirements: PO must include the Redwood account number and our internal BU code, invoices need to be consolidated monthly and map to our fiscal month (month-end cutover on the 31st), and our standard terms are Net60 for enterprise vendors.

Can Redwood accept Net60 for billing? If not, what are the constraints we should flag to our finance team so they can adjust the PO? I attached our standard PO template (see Orion_PO_Template_v3.pdf). We are aiming to issue the PO the week of 7/18 and would like to align the invoice cutover to your billing cycle to avoid duplicate pro-ration.

Thanks,
Kelly
Kelly Barnes
Procurement Manager — Orion Therapeutics
kelly.barnes@orionthera.com
+1 415-555-0199

Attachment: Orion_PO_Template_v3.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Kelly Barnes <kelly.barnes@orionthera.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO activation window and invoice cadence for Redwood deployment

Hi Kelly — thanks, and congrats on getting this across the finish line. A few notes from our side so procurement has clear options: 

Option A — Standard: Blanket PO + consolidated monthly invoicing (Net45). We will consolidate all usage for the month and emit a single invoice that references the PO number and your BU code. Our month-end cutover is the last calendar day; invoices are generated on the 1st business day after month-end and payment is due Net45 from invoice date.

Option B — Enterprise exception: We can accept Net60 for this account (as an exception) provided the PO is a signed blanket PO that includes the fields below (so our billing/ERP can map correctly):
- PO Number
- Billing Frequency: Monthly
- BU Code / Cost Center
- Billing Address and Invoice To email
- PO Type: Blanket or Standing Order

If you need Net60 we will require a short finance addendum (one paragraph) and our billing team will apply a small processing surcharge (0.5% of monthly invoice) to cover extended receivable risk. If that’s a non-starter, we can do Net45 with no surcharge.

I’m copying Vanessa (finance ops) and Vivek (revenue) to confirm ERP mapping and any other prerequisites. I’ve attached our PO acceptance checklist and a light spreadsheet that shows how we align invoice cutover to month boundaries.

What’s your target PO date? If you can get the signed blanket PO to us by 7/20 we can target the July invoice cycle; otherwise we’ll cutover on the next month boundary.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_PO_Acceptance_Checklist.pdf; Redwood_SOW_Invoice_Rhythm.xlsx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-11T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Orion PO fields + ERP mapping (need decision)

Team — quick internal note following Kelly's ask. Orion is asking for Net60 and wants a PO that aligns to their fiscal month. We can accommodate but need to confirm:

1) ERP mapping: our AP requires PO_Number and Cost_Center to be present in the PO PDF to auto-attach. If they place the BU code in a custom field we’ll need a matching map in our vendor table; otherwise these will be manual posts.
2) Invoice cutover: finance can run consolidated monthly invoices and release them on the 1st business day after month-end. To avoid a partial month double-bill we should request that the PO activation date be "Invoice Start Date: YYYY-MM-DD".
3) Net60 exception: I agree to the 0.5% processing surcharge for Net60. Vanessa — can you confirm the formal addendum language (one-liner) and whether 0.5% is sufficient from a finance risk perspective?

Please see the attached Redwood_SOW_Invoice_Rhythm.xlsx for the cutover examples (scenarios A/B/C). I recommend we provide Kelly with a sample PO PDF that includes the fields they will send so we avoid back-and-forth.

-Jordan

Attachment: Redwood_SOW_Invoice_Rhythm.xlsx

From: Kelly Barnes <kelly.barnes@orionthera.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Orion Therapeutics Procurement <procurement@orionthera.com>
Date: 2027-07-12T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO activation window and invoice cadence for Redwood deployment

Thanks Jordan — that is helpful. We can add the requested fields to our PO template; I’ll have procurement include PO_Number, BU Code, Billing Frequency, and Invoice Start Date in the PDF we issue.

One follow-up: our standard policy is Net60 and it is unlikely we can shorten that for enterprise vendors without special approval. We can include the one-line addendum you mentioned; procurement is okay with the 0.5% processing fee as a contractual note.

We will circulate the signed blanket PO by 2027-07-20 and route through DocuSign. Can you confirm Redwood’s acceptance process when we send the PO? (I.e., who signs on your side, and how quickly you return an invoice mapping confirmation?)

Subject: Re: PO activation window and invoice cadence for Redwood deployment

Kelly — thanks, that timeline works. To confirm next steps and acceptance criteria: 

- Redwood will accept the signed blanket PO (Orion_PO_Template_v3.pdf) with the following required fields present on the PDF: PO Number, BU Code, Billing Frequency, Invoice Start Date, and Billing Address.
- We will apply Net60 for this account as a signed enterprise exception for the first 12 months, with the agreed 0.5% processing surcharge applied to each monthly invoice. After 12 months we can revisit credit terms during the renewal conversation.
- Invoice cadence: Redwood will close usage on the last calendar day, generate consolidated invoices on the 1st business day post-month-end, and send the invoice to the Invoice To email provided on the PO. Payment will be due Net60 from invoice date.
- Acceptance process: Once we receive the signed PO via DocuSign we (Marissa and Vanessa) will confirm ERP mapping within 48 business hours and return a one-page invoice mapping confirmation. Please send DocuSign to finance@redwood.com and procurement@redwood.com; Jordan will countersign if required.

Please send the DocuSign link when you issue the PO. We’ll put the deal into our billing queue and note the OR-4921 net60 exception.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
